name: flashcommit
description: Generate commit messages using Claude Code CLI, Codex CLI, or the OpenAI-compatible / Anthropic APIs

flashcommit.provider.description: Backend used to generate commit messages.

flashcommit.prompt.default: Write a concise conventional commit message for this diff. Output only the message.
flashcommit.prompt.description: Instruction sent along with the diff.

flashcommit.claude.path.description: [Claude CLI] Path to the Claude Code CLI.

flashcommit.claude.model.description: [Claude CLI] Model passed as --model (empty = CLI default).

flashcommit.claude.allowedTools.description: [Claude CLI] Tools Claude Code may use without prompting, passed as --allowedTools (e.g. "Read", "Bash(git log:*)"). Empty = not passed.

flashcommit.claude.extraArgs.description: [Claude CLI] Extra arguments passed to claude -p.

flashcommit.codex.path.description: [Codex CLI] Path to the Codex CLI.

flashcommit.codex.model.description: [Codex CLI] Model passed as -m (empty = CLI default).

flashcommit.codex.extraArgs.description: [Codex CLI] Extra arguments passed to codex exec.

flashcommit.openai.baseUrl.markdownDescription: [OpenAI-compatible] OpenAI-compatible base URL (e.g. http://localhost:11434/v1 for Ollama). API key: [Set API Key](command:flashcommit.setApiKey?%5B%22openai%22%5D).

flashcommit.openai.model.description: [OpenAI-compatible] Model name for the OpenAI-compatible endpoint.

flashcommit.openai.headers.description: [OpenAI-compatible] Extra HTTP headers sent with each request (override the defaults).

flashcommit.anthropic.baseUrl.markdownDescription: [Anthropic] Base URL for the Messages API. API key: [Set API Key](command:flashcommit.setApiKey?%5B%22anthropic%22%5D).

flashcommit.anthropic.model.description: [Anthropic] Model name for the Messages API.

flashcommit.anthropic.headers.description: [Anthropic] Extra HTTP headers sent with each request (override the defaults).

scripts.compile: pnpm run check-types && pnpm run lint && node esbuild.js
scripts.package: pnpm run check-types && pnpm run lint && node esbuild.js --production
scripts.pretest: pnpm run compile-tests && pnpm run compile && pnpm run lint
